name: opl-flow
description: OPL Flow establishes the Codex experience baseline and coordinates durable work across tasks, repositories, and machines.

interface.shortDescription: Route OPL operations, software work, and Codex tasks
interface.longDescription: OPL Flow exposes three focused routers for OPL product operations, non-trivial software development, and native Codex task management. Specialized guides remain bundled and load only through the selected router. Framework and Codex own installation and Profile materialization; explicit $opl-flow start idempotently binds the Ledger through native owner APIs and fresh readback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opl-flow doctor to check my Codex baseline, or $opl-flow start for idempotent Ledger onboarding.
